title: Morphologies of the Peruvian mummies

tellings.quote: You have the J types, the S types, and the M types.

plain: The small mummified bodies from Peru that some people say are not human fall into three body types, called the J types, the S types and the M types. Michels names these types himself, in passing and without naming a source, and says nothing more about what sets each one apart.
